title: Production comedy script
script:
We started as Warelay. Then Clawdbot. Then Moltbot. Then OpenClaw. That's not indecision — that's a pivot so fast even the domain registrar needed therapy.

Our promise is simple: your assistant, on your devices, in your chats. All you need is an Android phone, an iPhone, a self-hosted deployment, three config files, and a casual disregard for your API bill.

Three hundred and eighty-seven thousand stars. And every single one of them opened an issue about setup complexity.
